## Critique
- claim-1: Supported by the accepted \(c=6\) artifact. The degreewise free ranks sum to \(1+1+2+1+1=6\); all remaining ranks and all torsion factors vanish. Thus \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\).
- claim-2: Correctly grounded by [source-2@L1382-L1421|claim=formal-document], together with the accepted parameter correspondence. Here \(a=b=2\), so each generating family has \(\binom42=6\) elements.
- claim-3: Correct. The two intervals specialize to the displayed six Schur classes. Generation gives \(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\), hence an isomorphism; therefore the quotient images form a basis and no proper subfamily generates \(J\).
- claim-4: The stated strategy reaches the exact requested target. Relative to the accepted computation, generation theorem, and indexed-family Nakayama criterion, the new \(i=j=p=2,c=6\) minimality corollary is established.
